verdict.rationale: ROS 2 documents topics as the interface for streaming sensor data, alongside static name remapping and shared message definitions, and its project description names drivers. A community comment confirms that agreed message packages let libraries interoperate without glue code. Together these let a driver node be swapped while consumers stay unchanged, but the pack shows only this message-level decoupling, not a dedicated hardware-abstraction layer for sensors and actuators. missing for 10: documented hardware-abstraction/controller interface layer for actuators, explicit docs on swapping drivers without code changes, hands-on evidence of sensor/actuator swaps in practice.
